revision_note: Only L2 integration accuracy refined from 1 ms to 0.25 ms after a numerical convergence check; stimulus, model parameters and diagnostic definitions unchanged. Earlier runs retained under outputs.
scope: Frozen engineering response benchmark; predictions, not new biological validation

flyvis.selection: Lexicographically first official pretrained model, selected before benchmark outcomes; not an ensemble result

l2.parameter_origin: Published rounded parameters already used by validate_l2_dynamics.py; no fit to this benchmark
l2.input: (weighted RGB code - 128/255)/(128/255); code contrast proxy, not photon contrast
l2.output: v, effective depolarization-positive state, arbitrary units; not dF/F, mV or Hz
l2.frame_convention: Zero-order-held frame on [t,t+dt); output at t+dt

flydrones.scope: Official Retina plus InputEncoder only; MiniFly provides group indices, no spiking network or motor simulation
flydrones.config: Upstream defaults.yaml unchanged; IMU yaw supplied as zero for synthetic stimuli

spatial_adapter.method: Project published MaleCNS rays with explicit intrinsics, interpolate Flyvis L2 at corresponding IMAGE positions using Delaunay weights within native BoxEye hull
spatial_adapter.interpretation: Image-space alignment only; NOT a verified Flyvis-to-MaleCNS cell identity map
spatial_adapter.unknown_policy: Missing directions, outside camera and outside Flyvis hull stay NaN/null; no black or zero replacement
spatial_adapter.optics: Native frontends retained: L2 center-ray bilinear sample, Flyvis 13x13 box, FlyDrones resized grids. Same RGB movies, different sampling footprints.

metrics: repeat maximum absolute difference in each native unit
baseline-subtracted peak magnitude and time for flash
wall time including native preprocessing, excluding initialization and file I/O
interpretation_rules: Direction readouts are diagnostics, not fitted classifiers
L2 direction/loom selectivity and FlyDrones L2 physiology are not covered
Software runtime is not neural latency or a full-brain speed ranking
Synthetic stimuli have no measured neural ground truth
Existing recordings are engineering replay, not independent physiology
No full-brain injection or conversion from model states to Hz
